reference.description: DOI or URL for the model.

runner.description: subprocess is reserved for in-repo reference models. Submissions use docker.

timestep.description: The step(s) the model can be run at, native step first. A single-step model lists one and is INCOMPATIBLE with probes that need another.

states.description: Absolute storage values, never tendencies. The harness differences them.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostic outputs that are neither fluxes nor stores, such as a surface temperature. Read by criteria, never integrated or differenced.

needs_static.description: static.json keys the adapter reads. A probe whose verdict rests on one requires it to be declared here.

window_days.description: Days of the scored record the model is evaluated on. The harness picks the largest flood event of that length after spinup, located by the probe's reference model. Omit for the default (30 days for PT1D, 7 for PT1H; reference models always see the full record) or set "full" to evaluate the whole record.
